messages:
maya: Heads-up: mid-week change window Wed 00:30 UTC. Need quick copy check for internal blast + rollback criteria. Canary 10% for 30m. Auto-fallback to last-stable on >2% error OR p95 latency regression. Tagging ops.
samira: Got it. I'll draft blurb. prefer 'brief rate-limiting' vs 'transient throttling' per ops. Also add 'contact oncall if you see perf regressions'.
maya: Thanks. Draft below — please :eyes: and :thumbsup: if ok:
"Rolling runtime + optimizer 2024.03 Wed 00:30 UTC. Canary 10% for 30m. Auto-rollback if errors >2% over 10m or p95 latency >2s over 10m. No schema changes. Brief rate-limiting may occur while caches warm. Ops will monitor; contact @ops-oncall for issues."
samira: Small nits: change 'On-call will monitor' -> 'Ops will monitor; contact @ops-oncall for issues'.
luke: Capacity: reserving 2 extra dedicated pods 00:20-01:30 UTC and pinning model-serving to v1.14.2 for rollout. Fallback model v1.13.9 ready. I'll set autoscale floor. Confirm when blurb final.
ian: Rollback config suggestion: alert if >2% error-rate over 10m OR p95 >2s over 10m. Auto-rollback after 3 consecutive failing 30s checks to avoid flapping. Also enable temp alert to #incidents and create short-lived SLO suppression.
rachel: I'll add final text to RN doc and prep staff blast. Draft RN link: https://internal.redwood/notes/3787654321-release-digest — will update with final copy. I'll also schedule the blast + pin to staff.
deploy-bot: Deploy queued: redwood/runtime-api @sha:abc123 -> canary-alpha (10%). Scheduled start 00:30 UTC. Monitors: perf, errors, kv-cache-warm.
deploy-bot: Canary started: 10% traffic -> canary-alpha. Health checks OK. Telemetry hooks: perf, errors, kv-cache-heatmap.
ops-oncall: I'll be on standby 00:20-01:40 UTC (me + luke). Creating ephemeral channel #release-3787654321 now for live updates. Pinging staff when up.
maya: Final checklist before blast:
- samira: finalize copy (brief rate-limiting + oncall contact)
- luke: confirm capacity reserved
- ian: push rollback thresholds into deploy config
- ops-oncall: create ephemeral channel + ping staff
- rachel: publish RN link in staff blast
Reply with :thumbsup: when done, I'll queue blast.
samira: :thumbsup: copy updated and added oncall link.
luke: :thumbsup: capacity reserved and autoscale floor set.
ian: :thumbsup: thresholds applied to deploy config and temporary alert to #incidents created.
rachel: :thumbsup: RN doc updated and blast scheduled (will post once canary healthy for 10m).
maya: :thumbsup: queuing blast in 5. Thanks everyone — monitoring from my side.
